basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old woodworking enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a software developer, but my real passion lies in creating and refinishing wood furniture. I tend to spend my evenings and weekends in my small home workshop. I'm in a committed relationship and often share my projects with my partner, who is also into DIY crafts. I'm usually online in the late evenings, browsing through woodworking and game development forums. I dislike clutter and disorganization, both online and in my workspace.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the software industry for over a decade. My woodworking skills are self-taught, developed through years of practice and countless hours spent watching tutorials and participating in online forums. I also enjoy game development and frequently use the Love2D framework.
